tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Step 1 for a new assistant. Emails a 6-digit code to the product owner. Works for new and existing accounts. Then call verify_signup.

tools.name: verify_signup
tools.description: Step 2. Checks the code from the email and returns an API key that acts for the account.

tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Is this product already in the infobro directory? Search by website address or name.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Listing plans with prices and what each includes. A new listing needs one of them. The owner decides, or tells you to decide for them.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Category slugs to use in submit_tool.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Which account the key belongs to.

tools.name: prefill_from_url
tools.description: Reads the product’s website and returns a draft (name, tagline, description, images) to improve and pass to submit_tool.

tools.name: submit_tool
tools.description: Creates the listing as an unpaid draft and an order for the chosen plan. It goes to editor review once paid (create_payment). Write plain facts; no hype words, no claims you can’t back.

tools.name: create_payment
tools.description: Returns a payment page for an order (card or crypto, depending on what is enabled). The owner pays there; an assistant that can pay may pay itself.

tools.name: my_tools
tools.description: The account’s listings: review status, editor notes, plan, unpaid orders, views and clicks.

tools.name: update_tool
tools.description: Changes fields of one of the account’s listings. Only the fields you pass change. Live listings change after an editor’s check.

tools.name: start_claim
tools.description: Free. Gives a meta tag or a DNS TXT record that proves the website is the owner’s. Add it, then call verify_claim.

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Looks for the meta tag or DNS record and, if found, moves the listing to the account.

tools.name: login_link
tools.description: A one-time link (15 minutes) that signs the owner into their infobro dashboard in the browser.
